rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and zip, matching a single user via tools. The agent viewed relevant orders and product details before acting and operated only on the authenticated user’s orders. However, there were two policy breaches: (1) the agent updated the shipping address on the pending watch order without first stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation to proceed; (2) the agent modified the silicone watch to a metal white variant and processed the refund without first getting explicit confirmation. For the air purifier request, the agent correctly noted the order was pending (thus not eligible for exchange), asked for confirmation to modify the pending order item, and then performed the change and correctly reflected the price difference. Despite correct execution of changes and accurate information, the missing confirmations before the first two order-changing writes violate the stated policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
